member.name: M:RoR2BepInExPack.Utilities.NativeDetourExtensions.GenerateTrampolineWithRecursionSupport``1(MonoMod.RuntimeDetour.NativeDetour,System.UInt32)
member.summary:
Generate a new delegate with which you can invoke the previous state. Instead of an "undo-call-redo" trampoline generated with copies bytesCount bytes from original method into the trampoline and then puts detour back to the original method, effectively splitting the method.
This way of doing trampoline has restrictions:
Part of the method that is in trampoline can't have jumps.
The method split should happen between two instructions, so you need to supply the amount of bytes that is >= 14 (max size of a detour) and is on the edge of an instruction.
member.param: The amount of bytes to copy from original method
